title: Prospective prescribed-groundwater-level branch-boundary characterization

dependencies.live_inside_profile: GC-LOW01-B qualification required only for solver-response part, not classifier-only characterization

frozen_source_tolerances_cm.note: No tolerance is invented for the physical bottom face; BELOW_BOTTOM_NODE is a node-center state-machine classification and is deliberately distinguished from below the actual profile face.

solver_extension_if_low01b_passes: Repeat a bounded subset immediately on either side of one internal node using the qualified OUTPUT01/LOW01-B carrier.
Record qbot, storage change and candidate-state norm without requiring continuity.
Treat retry/nonconvergence as evidence of the branch envelope, not as a reason to retune the controls.
gates: Classifier outputs exactly follow the frozen source state-machine rules for every predeclared control.
Node-snap cases demonstrate the 1e-4 cm source tolerance without post-hoc movement.
The report explicitly distinguishes BELOW_BOTTOM_NODE from H_phreatic below the physical bottom face.
Any solver-response discontinuity is reported descriptively; LOW01-C has no continuity acceptance requirement.
interpretation: LOW01-C is a characterization gate, not an admission gate.
A discontinuity can be historically correct and still be a design concern for a future h-link; the test must not smooth it away.
The physical bottom face at -300 cm is not the legacy mode-1 branch-switch point. The state machine switches when all node centers are above H_phreatic, which occurs below z4=-250 cm.
forbidden: no claim of continuity unless directly observed
